purpose: Teach: 気功/狂牛病/磁場/下水道/社会保険庁/地表/脱臼/精油

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、中国伝統の気功療法を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on traditional Chinese qigong therapy, didn't you?
lines.style: Steady, warm interest. Light confirmation-seeking lilt on the closing. Leaning in slightly—teacher noticing her student's work with genuine attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、狂牛病パンデミックの歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, my paper was on the history of the mad cow disease pandemic.
lines.style: Clear, matter-of-fact correction. No defensiveness—just straightforward. Meets her teacher's eyes. Slight pause before answering, like she's used to being misremembered.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地球磁場の変動研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you researched fluctuations in Earth's magnetic field for your paper, right?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Slight pause before the closing, like Asuka is processing Sakura's previous answer. Curious but unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦後の下水道整備史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No—my paper was actually on the history of postwar sewage infrastructure development.
lines.style: Patient but clear. She's correcting again without irritation. Slightly faster cadence, settling into the rhythm of these corrections. Grounded in her own knowledge.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会保険庁の不祥事史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Then you covered the Social Insurance Agency scandal history in your work?
lines.style: Engaged, attentive follow-up. Slight rise at the end—checking in, still trying to pin down what Sakura actually researched. Warm but genuinely curious now.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、地表温度の長期変動を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I wrote about long-term fluctuations in surface temperature.
lines.style: Steady, unhurried. She's patient with the repetition. Slight exhale before speaking, like she's taking this in stride. Genuine but measured.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 肩関節脱臼のリハビリを論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So your paper focused on rehabilitation protocols for shoulder dislocation?
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful. A little slower now—Asuka's own curiosity becoming genuine uncertainty. Still warm, still listening closely.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ラベンダー精油の鎮静効果を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, it was on the sedative effects of lavender essential oil.
lines.style: Final correction, delivered with quiet confidence. Slight finality in the closing—she's settled into who she is and what she's actually done. Warm but complete.
